phase: Canonical checklist and Growroom status ownership
findings: After HOME-14 extracted V366, the renderer still calculated Growroom readiness without the live-weather multiplier and rendered the lower Growroom strip from ready-count instead of active plants.
Frost-Todesritter still rendered a six-slot equipment checklist first and HOME-6 corrected it afterward with a second DOM pass.
changes: The beta home renderer now owns the seven-slot Frost checklist including weapon2.
Checklist totals are rendered from the actual class slot count instead of hard-coded /6 values.
The renderer now owns the same weather-aware Growroom readiness formula used by the Growroom and exposes it for targeted timer/weather refreshes.
The lower Growroom strip is correct on first render: active plants plus ready count.
The obsolete Frost post-render checklist patch and its repeated DOM work are retired.
The Growroom targeted timer/weather updater remains for real-time transitions without polling or full-home rebuilds.
